description: Header file defining the TestPlayerStub class, which wraps a dynamically loaded test media player for Android's media framework. It includes method declarations for setting data sources, controlling playback, and managing the underlying player instance.

classes.name: TestPlayerStub
classes.description: A wrapper class around a dynamically loaded test media player, implementing MediaPlayerInterface.

methods.description: Constructor for the TestPlayerStub class.

methods.description: Checks if the current build allows test players.
